title: Transform Binary String Using Subsequence Sort
summary: Given binary s and same-length patterns containing 0,1,?, decide separately for each pattern whether some replacement of its question marks is reachable from s. An operation chooses any subsequence of current s and sorts its selected values nondecreasingly back into the same positions. All other positions stay unchanged; operations may repeat or be omitted.
officialConstraints: Length1..2000; 1..2000 patterns, each matching s's length.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
